product_family: Semantic Scholar is a free, AI-powered academic literature search and discovery tool operated as a Research and Product Development team within Ai2 (nonprofit). Sub-products include the public web app, Semantic Reader (beta augmented reader), and the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API for developers.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: no trust center, security page, or SOC 2 report/badge found on semanticscholar.org or allenai.org after checking the homepage, about page, privacy policy, and API license

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence: not mentioned in Ai2's privacy policy, Semantic Scholar about page, or API license agreement

certifications.name: ISO 27017/27018/27701
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence found on vendor domain

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence found on vendor domain; Ai2 emphasizes open-source transparency practices but no formal ISO 42001 certification claim located

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence found on vendor domain

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence; not mentioned anywhere on semanticscholar.org or allenai.org, and the product does not handle protected health information

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: not applicable / no public evidence; Semantic Scholar is a free service with no payment processing on the platform

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence found on vendor domain

certifications.name: GDPR (posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: Provided that you reside in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, or that GDPR otherwise applies, you have the following data subject rights in accordance with the EU GDPR...

privacy.ai_training_note: For general use of Semantic Scholar (search, browsing, author pages) there is no indication of training on private user data; the underlying corpus is public/licensed academic literature. For interactive AI demo features, the privacy policy states: 'we process any personal data included in those prompts exclusively based on your consent and to improve our AI demonstrations...' indicating consent-based use of prompt data to improve demo features specifically, not a blanket statement about all products or an explicit opt-out mechanism being described.
privacy.data_region: United States (privacy policy states: 'Your information will be stored and processed by Ai2 in the United States,' with Standard Contractual Clauses / Data Privacy Framework safeguards for EEA transfers)

security.name: Encryption in transit/at rest
security.value: Not specified. Privacy policy only states a general commitment: 'We work hard to protect information you provide from loss, misuse, and unauthorized access or disclosure,' with no detail on encryption standards.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: A security.txt file is published at semanticscholar.org/.well-known/security.txt listing security@allenai.org as the security contact (expires 2027-03-01), indicating a basic responsible-disclosure channel exists.

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Personal information retained only as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, per the privacy policy.

security.name: Third-party/legal contact for security safeguards
security.value: Further information on safeguards can be requested by email at legal@allenai.org.

products.name: Semantic Scholar (web app)
products.data_scope: Public academic paper metadata, user account info (email, name) if registered, optional claimed author-page data
products.notes: No paid tier; free for all users, no enterprise SLA or trust center.

products.name: Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API
products.data_scope: Public/licensed academic literature data (S2 Data under CC BY-NC / ODC-BY style licenses); API key usage logged
products.notes: Governed by a separate API License Agreement; rate-limited, attribution required, liability capped at $100.

products.name: Semantic Reader
products.data_scope: Same public paper corpus, contextual AI annotations for select papers
products.notes: Beta feature, limited to select papers; no distinct security disclosures found.

flags: No trust center and no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI evidence was found anywhere on the vendor's own domains (semanticscholar.org, allenai.org); this is consistent with a free, nonprofit research tool rather than an over-claim.

AI-training data usage is ambiguous outside the specific 'AI demonstrations' consent clause; no explicit statement covers whether the core search/API corpus processing trains any Ai2 models on user-submitted (vs. public paper) data, and no opt-out mechanism is described.

Semantic Scholar has no separate legal entity or privacy policy of its own; all privacy/legal terms are Ai2's, so certifications or incidents attributed to 'Ai2' broadly cover Semantic Scholar too. Any AWS/cloud-host certifications would belong to the host, not Ai2/Semantic Scholar.
